To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a remote laboratory for three tank hydraulic system using Matlab, WebSockets and JavaScript is presented.
the new architecture of a Matlab based remote laboratory can enable the remote laboratory to run on a web browser and the remote laboratory can be implemented in 3D.

the proposed architecture for building remote laboratories is based on the Matlab/Simulinik computing and simulation software and the WebSocket communication technology, that the client interface is realized in the form of web application in JavaScript and the Three.js library is used for 3D visualization, and that the remote laboratory is designed for comparison of feedback control with feedforward control and the use of a nonlinear disturbance observer in both cases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new remote laboratory for three tank hydraulic system that can be used for education and research purposes.
the development of a new architecture for virtual and remote laboratories based on the Matlab/Similink, WebSocket communication technology, and JavaScript.
the development of a new remote laboratory architecture where the Matlab computing and simulation software is used as a server side component and JavaScript as a client side one.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented remote laboratory is a good candidate for the education of control engineering students.
the presented remote laboratory has been created as a new architecture for the future development of virtual and remote laboratories in Matlab environment.
the presented remote laboratory has a potential to be an educational tool for the students of control engineering and mechatronics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the new architecture has been tested on a three tank hydraulic system where the nonlinear control algorithms have been implemented and the results have been compared with the results from the real system.
the proposed architecture can be considered as an important step towards a more flexible and user-friendly remote laboratory.
the presented architecture is a new way of building remote laboratories and can be considered as an alternative to the previous Matlab based remote laboratories.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presented remote laboratory can be used as a teaching tool for the control theory and as a research platform for control design and implementation.
it is possible to build a remote laboratory for the three-tank system with a Matlab server and JavaScript client side application that can run on a web browser.
the new remote laboratory can serve as a platform for the education of nonlinear and adaptive control and for the research of nonlinear systems.
